How It Works

Three steps. No setup needed.

01

Scan Your Device

Drop a photo. Our simulated AI matches it against 1,000+ Indian household device profiles and returns a lifecycle estimate.

02

Get Matched & Scored

See component-level breakdown, resale value in INR, EPR category, and months-remaining estimate.

03

Dispose Responsibly

Generate a verified EPR record for unusable components. Download your compliance history for ESG reporting.
